content.title: Shake Shack and TripAdvisor get upgraded, volatility spikes
content.description:
Yahoo Finance Markets and Data Editor Jared Blikre tracks Friday's top moving stocks and biggest market stories in this Market Minute.

The CBOE Volatility Index (^VIX) spiked to a four-week high.

Shake Shack (SHAK) was upgraded to Buy from Hold by Loop Capital.

TripAdvisor (TRIP) was upgraded to Neutral from Underperform by Mizuho Securities.

Stay up to date on the latest market action, minute-by-minute, with Yahoo Finance's Market Minute.
